transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I’m Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... I guess my mind just keeps going blank. At the worst times, really. Like, I'll look at the road-closure forms at work, or... or my stop-slow paddle, and I suddenly can't remember the steps. Things I've done for years. It just... goes empty. So, that's why I'm here.
Have you noticed any problems with your memory or thinking, like forgetting recent events or having trouble concentrating, outside of these moments when your mind goes blank?

I don't... I'm not really sure about other times. It's mostly just what I just said. Just... standing there with the paddle, or looking at the forms, and... the steps are just gone. That's really all I can think of.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy?

I guess... yeah. Mostly in the mornings. I just... wake up and there's this heavy feeling. Like a hollow kind of sadness right in my chest. It just feels like... like the whole day is already ruined before I even get out of bed.
Have you been feeling fatigued or lacking energy most days, even when you haven’t done anything physically or mentally exhausting?
I don't know... I guess I'm just tired. I mean, standing outside all day takes it out of you anyway, so... it's hard to tell. I just feel tired.
Can you describe a time when you felt tired even after resting or not doing anything physically demanding?
I don't really... I can't think of a specific time. I'm just tired. I don't really keep track of... whether I was resting first, or what. I just don't know.
On days when you haven’t been doing much—like days off or quiet days at home—do you still feel just as tired and low on energy?
Um... I don't really do much on my days off anyway. Just sit around, mostly. So... maybe? I'm just always kind of drained. I don't really pay attention to it.
Have you noticed that you don’t take pleasure in things anymore—like things you used to enjoy, even a little bit?
I don't really know. Um... I haven't noticed, I guess. I don't really do much besides work anyway, so... I'm not sure what I'd be enjoying.
Can you think of any activity or moment, even a small one, that used to bring you some enjoyment, even a little, but now feels like it doesn’t anymore?

I used to... I guess I used to do a lot. Like, organizing the rides for choir, or... doing the garden swaps. I used to bring snacks for the youth basketball games. But... I don't know. Now I just... I sit there. I can just stare at my phone for hours, and I see people messaging me, but... I don't feel like answering. I just don't have the push to do it anymore.

Has there been a noticeable change in how you feel about activities you used to enjoy, like organizing choir rides or doing garden swaps—like not caring about them anymore, or not wanting to do them even if you know you should?

Yeah... I guess so. Like I said... I just don't care anymore. I used to do all those things... the rides, the swaps, the snacks. But now... I just don't. I just look at my phone and... I don't feel like doing any of it.
Would you say that most days, even when there’s nothing particularly stressful happening, you still feel that heavy, hollow sadness you mentioned?
Yeah... I guess so. Most mornings, I just... I wake up and it's there. Just this heavy... hollow feeling right in my chest. It's like... before I even get out of bed, the day is already ruined.
Do you feel that heavy, hollow sadness most of the day, even when nothing bad is happening around you?

Yeah... like I just said. I mean, it doesn't matter if anything bad is happening or not. I just wake up with it, and... the day is already ruined before my feet even hit the floor. It's just always there.
Would you say that your mood has been depressed most of the day, nearly every day, not just in the mornings or at certain times?
Yeah... I mean, I already told you about the mornings. It's... it's just there. The heavy feeling. It doesn't really go away.

Have you completely lost interest in all the things you used to enjoy, like organizing choir rides or doing garden swaps, or is there still some part of you that cares but you just don’t feel like doing them anymore?

I just... I don't care anymore. I used to do all that stuff... the choir rides, the garden swaps, snacks for the youth basketball team. But now... I don't know. I can just sit there for hours. Staring at my phone. I see the messages... I just don't feel any push to answer them.
Have you been feeling like you’re a failure or that you’ve let people down, even when there’s no real reason to think that?

I guess so. I just... I keep thinking about all the things I didn't do. For my friend, the choir... my family. I just replay it all in my head. I feel pretty useless. Like... like I deserve whatever punishment is coming my way.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently—like eating a lot less or more than usual, or losing or gaining weight without trying?

I guess... food doesn't really mean much right now. I don't really think about it. I just skip meals, I suppose. I didn't really notice until... my work pants started feeling loose. My family said I look kind of drawn. But I just... don't have an appetite.
Would you say that you’ve completely stopped getting any pleasure or satisfaction from things you used to enjoy, even a little bit?
I don't know... I guess so. I just don't feel much of anything when I try to do them.
